checkpoint_scope: Verification-only one-update actor, not a behavior candidate or validated deployment actor

contract.missing: NaN, inf, no hit and dropout map to sensor_max; no validity mask
contract.action: tanh Gaussian; two normalized wheel rim speeds in [-1,1], positive forward
contract.previous_action: previous saturated requested command, not measured velocity
contract.reset: Zero each robot GRU and local geometry only at episode/controller reset; preserve both across switches/occlusion
contract.switch: same actor and hidden; new task before next control action; world preserved
contract.roles: robot 0 preassigned leader; others followers; role is not predecessor identity

sensor_model.aggregation: minimum nearest-surface distance over a closed horizontal cone
sensor_model.noise_stage: configured scalar noise/dropout after cone aggregation
sensor_model.vertical_model: planar surfaces only; no vertical zones or floor returns
sensor_model.hardware_match: unmeasured assumption; VL53L7CX zone aggregation unconfirmed

raw_sensor_observation_contract.missing: NaN, inf, no hit and dropout map to sensor_max; no validity mask
raw_sensor_observation_contract.action: tanh Gaussian; two normalized wheel rim speeds in [-1,1], positive forward
raw_sensor_observation_contract.previous_action: previous saturated requested command, not measured velocity
raw_sensor_observation_contract.reset: zero hidden, previous command and sensor queue at episode/controller reset only
raw_sensor_observation_contract.switch: same actor and hidden; new task before next control action; world preserved
raw_sensor_observation_contract.roles: robot 0 preassigned leader; others followers; role is not predecessor identity

sensor_model.aggregation: minimum nearest-surface distance over a closed horizontal cone
sensor_model.noise_stage: configured scalar noise/dropout after cone aggregation
sensor_model.vertical_model: planar surfaces only; no vertical zones or floor returns
sensor_model.hardware_match: unmeasured assumption; VL53L7CX zone aggregation unconfirmed

contract.information: Derived solely from local anonymous six-range/own-request history; no true poses, identities, classes, counts, visibility or evaluator assignment
contract.body_slots: Up to6 local body-shaped hypotheses sorted by current bearing, zero padded; not persistent neighbor identities or a hardware validity mask

action_decoding.mapping: Fold steering direction to the nearer forward/reverse heading using x sign; forward component sets signed speed and learned drive scale multiplies it. Convert(v,omega) through configured wheel separation/rim-speed and independently saturate each wheel.
action_decoding.physical_action: Only two wheel requests; vector y is a steering intent, never lateral translation or a pose/target command.
action_decoding.information: Decoder receives only three learned bounded outputs and calibration; no observation, teacher, environment, collision flag or formation rule.

contract.policy_density: Any future PPO log probability belongs to the3-dimensional tanh latent distribution, before deterministic wheel decoding. Store actual latents and actual decoded wheels separately; no wheel-space density/Jacobian claim.
contract.initialization: Encoder/GRU parameters match the fresh geometry actor. First two numerical head rows are copied with new meaning; third starts at zero. Initial wheel function is intentionally different and is not a matched-output control.

decoder.mapping: Fold steering direction to the nearer forward/reverse heading using x sign; forward component sets signed speed and learned drive scale multiplies it. Convert(v,omega) through configured wheel separation/rim-speed and independently saturate each wheel.
decoder.physical_action: Only two wheel requests; vector y is a steering intent, never lateral translation or a pose/target command.
decoder.information: Decoder receives only three learned bounded outputs and calibration; no observation, teacher, environment, collision flag or formation rule.

excluded: Compiler stack/spills, firmware/runtime, I-O, heaps and actual target flash/RAM placement; partial counts do not establish peak RAM or deadline compliance.
scope: Actor-only FP32 C++ pipeline with real preprocessing/geometry/GRU/decoder over identical sensor/previous-command/task/reset sequences. Critic, optimizer, teacher and log_std are excluded. Host-only operator feasibility; no target/device/behavior acceptance.
